INTERVENORS-RESPONDENTS’ BRIEF 26
27 On June 12, 2023, LUBA received intervenors-respondents’ brief. OAR
28 661-010-0050(6)(b) provides that intervenors-respondents’ brief must satisfy the
requirements for a respondent’s brief in OAR 661-010-0035. Intervenors- 29
30 respondents’ brief is not signed on the last page by the author as required by OAR
31 661-010-0035(2) and OAR 661-010-0030(2)(j). Within seven days of the date of
32 this order, intervenors-respondents shall file and serve a replacement last page of
Page 2
their brief, signed by the author of intervenors-respondent’s 1 brief, along with a
2 certificate of service and filing.
3 NOTICE OF RELATED MATTERS
4 OAR 661-010-0012(7) provides that
5 “When a party files a notice of intent to appeal, a motion to
6 intervene, or a brief, if the party is aware of another appeal pending
7 before the Board or in another forum that involves the same or a
8 closely related land use matter, then the party shall file a notice with
9 the Board identifying the related matter by title and case number.
10 The notice may not be combined with another document. A party
11 may likewise notify the Board if the party is aware of another matter
12 pending in another forum that raises the same or a closely related
13 issue. A party need not notify the Board of a related matter if another
14 party has already done so.”
15 Within seven days of the date of this order, the parties shall notify the
16 Board if they are aware of another matter in another forum raising the same or a
17 related matter to that raised in the briefing in this case.
